text: The encyclopedia directs readers from Battle of Mag Tuired to the entry on Mag Tuired. Two great battles were fought on that plain, both won by the Tuatha Dé Danann. See Mag Tuired.

key_results: The Battle of Mag Tuired entry points to Mag Tuired.
Two great battles took place on the plain of Mag Tuired.
The Tuatha Dé Danann won both battles.
